newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security bodies ready to implement the new residency law; Tough penalties against illegal immigrants, workers starting Oct 1.
- Swimmers warned to stay clear of three Fujairah areas after two young UAE nationals drowned.
- Iran, U.S. vie for influence in northern Iraq.
- Rent in capital unlikely to drop, says official.
- Marriage Fund not to increase grants; 70,000 dirhams enough to meet expenses, says the Fund's director.
- Dubai malls to have home page on Internet.
- Emirates Airlines reduces fares on selected routes.
